conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Alvenor.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 5. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 14.9 | 7.5 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 11.6 | 5.8 | 600 |
